outcome: Changes in internal anal sphincter thickness
Changes in external anal sphincter thickness
cohort: 10 nulliparous women who underwent 3T MRI before their first pregnancy and at least 6 months postpartum
finding: There were no significant changes in internal or external anal sphincter measurements from prepregnancy to postdelivery in nulliparous women.
mod_finding: There were no statistically significant changes from prepregnancy to postdelivery in any IAS or EAS location for the entire cohort, those with vaginal birth, or after Cesarean.
